text:
Maya G: Heads up — Compliance just asked for 360d auth/login retention and a way to "playback" event sequences for auditors. Can we do that without exposing PII?
Diego S: Storage + cost are immediate blockers. Playback = export + replay in a sandbox?
Maya G: Yes, auditors want to walk through sequences tied to session IDs. Redacted content is okay if provenance is preserved.
Priya Sec: High-level security goals: CMK-protected raw archive, 2-approver unwrap, immutable audit trail of unwraps, RBAC scoped auditor roles, and network-isolated replays.
Lukas Eng: Proposed engineering approach: keep live SIEM retention at 90d, mirror raw events to a CMK-wrapped forensic bucket with 400d lifecycle. Exports generate a timeboxed "playback bundle" (sanitized jsonl + manifest) that is imported into an ephemeral sandbox for auditors.
oncall-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4899 - forensic-archive + playback flow (https://tickets.internal/SEC-4899)
Compliance-Ana: Auditors require step-through capability but cannot get interactive access to production SIEM. Sandbox playback acceptable as long as hashes + provenance are included.
Diego S: Implementation notes: need kms-proxy with an approval service, manifest with object hashes + cmk key id, and tokenization keys rotated separately. Also need cost estimate for storage + sandbox compute.
Lukas Eng: We can build unwrap via kms-proxy that issues short-lived signed URLs after approval. Suggest default playback TTL=12h, triage TTL=4h. All unwrap events logged to WORM audit stream.
Priya Sec: Approvals: Sec lead + Compliance required for external auditors; include Legal for high-risk scopes. Approver policy 2-of-3 from [SecLead, Compliance, Legal].
Maya G: Good. Also want an explicit human review step if the bundle contains flagged sensitive fields before any external release.
Lukas Eng: Draft config snippet for the unwrap flow:
```yaml
unwrap_flow:
  approvers_required: 2
  ttl_hours: 12
  tags: ["forensic_playback"]
  scrub_policy: "pii_masked_unless_legal"
```
Diego S: Add triage tag example: `tags: ["forensic_playback","triage"]` with ttl_hours:4 and required justification field.
Compliance-Ana: Sandbox requirements: ephemeral VPC, ingest sanitized bundle only, auditor accounts get viewer role with short-lived MFA sessions, no egress except auditor IPs.
Priya Sec: Also require manifest fields: requestor, approvers, justification, cmk_key_id, bundle_hash, created_at. Record unwrap to immutable audit sink (splunk or audit-store).
Diego S: Cost rough estimate: storage + packaging + ephemeral sandbox about $2.2k/month per active audit. Need finance + procurement signoff for recurring audits.
Maya G: Vulnerability triage overlap: when we see exploit telemetry, triage team may request 4h playback for analysts. Reuse same flow but with `triage` tag and stricter logging.
Lukas Eng: Implementation caveat: tokenization keys must be rotated independently of CMKs; ensure tokenization service denies raw outputs unless unwrap flow used.
oncall-bot: SEC-4899 linked to #ops and will notify on bundle creation and unwrap events.
Priya Sec: Action items:
- Lukas: design kms-proxy changes + manifest schema (48h)
- Priya: write RBAC matrix + approver matrix + RFC text (72h)
- Diego: cost breakdown + sandbox playbook (48h)
- Maya: coordinate Compliance + Legal signoff and open RFC link to SEC-4899 (ASAP)
Compliance-Ana: Quick Q: do we allow partner auditors to run ad-hoc queries against the sandbox? Prefer no — only playback bundles.
Maya G: Agreed, disallow interactive querying. Playback only.
Lukas Eng: One more note: include HIL review step if `scrub_policy` flags redactions that would materially change sequence meaning.
Diego S: ACK. Tagging @Legal-Team for visibility.
Maya G: If no objections I'll open an RFC and attach the ticket.
Priya Sec: No objections from Sec. I'll start the draft.
Lukas Eng: ✅
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: update SEC-4899 in 48h with designs.
Maya G: Thanks everyone.
